name: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
credit: Qing album portrait of Emperor Gaozu of Han · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Liu Bang (256–195 BC), born a commoner in Pei, rose through the rebellion against the Qin dynasty and defeated Xiang Yu to found the Han dynasty in 202 BC. As Emperor Gaozu he ruled until his death.

Two short songs are credited to him: the “Song of the Great Wind,” said to have been sung on a visit to his home district after a campaign, and the “Song of the Swan,” sung when he despaired of changing his succession. They are preserved in the Shiji and the Han shu.

poems.title: 大風歌 (Da feng ge)
poems.author: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
poems.collection: Shiji juan 8; Han shu juan 1; Gushi yuan (1719) juan 2
poems.text:
大風起兮雲飛揚，
威加海內兮歸故鄉。
安得猛士兮守四方？

poems.title: 鴻鵠歌 (Hong hu ge)
poems.author: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
poems.collection: Shiji juan 8; Han shu juan 1; Gushi yuan (1719) juan 2
poems.text:
鴻鵠高飛
一舉千里
羽翼已就
橫絕四海
橫絕四海
又可奈何
星有繒繳
將安所施
